name: Bizzi Reviews Pro
description: Collect, moderate and display Google, Facebook, WooCommerce and manual reviews with beautiful widgets, star badges and SEO schema.

notes: Facebook: moved to Graph API v23.0 (v19.0 has been retired by Meta).
Facebook: a Page admin's user token is now swapped for the Page token automatically.
Facebook: Recommendations (positive/negative) are imported when there is no star rating.
Facebook: errors now show Facebook's own message and what to fix, instead of only 'API returned status 403'.
Plugin Check clean-up: all template and admin-screen variables are now prefixed.
Free plugin 1.3.3 and Pro 1.1.2 pass Plugin Check with no errors or warnings in the code-review, prefixing, database, query and escaping checks.
Security: all template output is now late-escaped with wp_kses allow-lists, in line with WordPress.org Plugin Check.
Free plugin 1.3.2 passes the official Plugin Check with no errors.
Pro is now an add-on for the free Bizzi Reviews plugin (no review limits in either). Pro £29/year, Agency £99/year.
Server-side licence activation with automatic daily checks.
Automatic updates from the Bizzi Reviews update server.
New in-dashboard Help page with step-by-step guides.
Gutenberg blocks now render live previews on the front end.
Security hardening: stricter input validation, escaped output, stronger token encryption.
